subject: bookshelf
name: 书架
label: 阶梯形书架
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One distinctive stepped bookcase in mild three-quarter view with three staggered open compartments, six large books and one simple bookend.
Strictly keep the stated number of objects; large spaced clear shapes. Book spines if present are plain empty rectangles, no lettering or tiny bands. No decorative carving, texture, woodgrain, shadows or gray wash. Realistic connected furniture structure. Whole object with generous surrounding margin.
